class.name: MessageData
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for messages sent between nodes.
class.description: Abstract base class of all message data, used with [method Node.send_message] and [method Node._message]. Extend it to define custom messages: deliver a message with [method Node.send_message] to any node, and it is passed to that node's [method Node._message] before propagating to the node's children, depth-first. While it travels, every node receives the same [MessageData] instance, so a single object can carry data between the sender and every receiver. The propagation stops as soon as the message is marked as handled with [method set_message_as_handled], when [member handled] is set to [code]true[/code], or when a script's [method Node._message] returns and the message is already handled.

method.name: is_handled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the message has been marked as handled. A handled message stops propagating to further nodes.

method.name: set_handled
method.description: Marks the message as handled. A handled message stops propagating to further nodes. Equivalent to setting [member handled] directly.

method.name: set_message_as_handled
method.description: Marks the message as handled ([code]true[/code]). A handled message stops propagating to further nodes, so no other node receives it afterward.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the message is considered handled and [method Node.send_message] stops delivering it to further nodes.
